nom: Avène PhysioLift Serum, Smoothing, Plumping Serum, Hyaluronic Acid to Reduce Appearance of Wrinkles, 1 Oz

avis.texte: The texture and smell is good. It’s not greasy. I like the product.

avis.titre: Scent is strong - gave bottle away
avis.texte: The scent was strong and stinky. I gave the bottle to my friend so I cannot give an opinion if the lotion works.

This may be a bit expensive BUT IT WORKS !!!! I have little fat in my face so I have deep wrinkles on both cheeks and on forehead. I tried it and you just need a little but rub it in and the wrinkles honestly disappeared !!!! Then I put on light make up and looked 10-20 yrs younger! BUY IT
I love these line of products. This serum is great with one exception it has a slightly weird scent when you first apply it thankfully it goes away after application.
E' un prodotto ottimo sia per la notte che per il giorno abbinato alla crema della stessa linea
